title: League, Morley-Minto, Lucknow: more provisions and context

boxes.title: League: aims & sessions
items: Founded at session of **All-India Muhammadan Educational Conference**
Aims: ==**loyalty to the British Empire**==; safeguard Muslim interests; keep Muslims from Congress
Simla demand basis: Muslims' "contribution to the empire's defence"
**1912-24**: dominated by younger Muslim nationalists; **"Young Party"** (Jinnah, **Ali Brothers**)
**A.K. Fazlul Haq**: Lahore Resolution; **Liaquat Ali Khan**: Pakistan movement

boxes.title: 1909 Act: more provisions
head: Area
Detail
rows: Non-official majority, but **Governor's veto** left them powerless
Supplementary questions, move resolutions; ==no questions on military affairs==

cards.title: Lucknow Dec 1916
lines: **Annie Besant** also worked for the Pact
Also: separation of executive and judiciary; ==elected majority in provincial legislatures==

items.what: ==Partition annulled== at **Delhi Durbar** (King George V); capital Calcutta → Delhi
Rowlatt Act; **Jallianwala Bagh** (**13 April**); 1919 Act: bicameralism, direct elections at Centre
League alleges "**Hindu Raj**" under Congress ministries

boxes.title: Exam corner (more)
items: ⚠ UPSC notes wrongly say Minto "expanded the Indian Councils Act in **1919**": 1919 Act = **Chelmsford**
Lahore 1940: independent states for Muslims; Iqbal's **Allahabad** address; Rahmat Ali's **Now or Never**
AP: **Bodi Narayana Rao** arrested with Gadicherla (**Swarajya** article)
